description: This header file declares utility functions for parsing WebRTC session descriptions, ICE candidates, and error messages from JSON, as well as generating ICE server configuration messages. It is part of the WebRTC streaming module in the Cuttlefish project, facilitating signaling and connection setup through JSON messages.

methods.name: ParseSessionDescription
methods.description: Parses a WebRTC session description from a JSON message, returning a unique pointer to a SessionDescriptionInterface wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: ParseIceCandidate
methods.description: Parses an ICE candidate message from JSON, returning a unique pointer to an IceCandidateInterface in a Result.

methods.name: ParseError
methods.description: Parses an error message from JSON, returning an error string wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: ParseIceServersMessage
methods.description: Extracts and parses ICE server configurations from a JSON message into a vector of IceServer objects.

methods.name: GenerateIceServersMessage
methods.description: Creates a JSON message representing a list of ICE servers.
